exposure: Women with and without hyperglycemia in pregnancy (HIP)
Implementation of IADPSG/WHO guidelines for gestational diabetes
outcome: Neonatal intensive care unit/special care nursery admission
cohort: Women with singleton pregnancies in Belgium
finding: After the implementation of IADPSG/WHO guidelines, the prevalence of HIP increased, but the incidence of major HIP-related pregnancy complications appears to be lower.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean section rates increased overall but not in the HIP population.
